name: Hover Card
summary: Contextual preview surface revealed on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
description: Contextual preview surface revealed on pointer hover or keyboard focus. Use compact density for brief descriptions and detailed density when supporting metadata is needed. Sizing policy: fixed/default width with Hug Contents height.

density.detailed: Roomier, for richer content than the default carries.

dos: Reference variables for every value; never hardcode a hex or px.
Change state through props, never by detaching the instance.
Open and close on a delay, so passing the pointer over does not trigger it.
Keep it open while the pointer travels into it.
Treat everything in it as an enhancement of the link's own destination.
donts: Do not place the only copy of an action inside one.
Do not open it on click — that is a Popover.
whenToUse: Preview the thing behind a link on hover, without making the reader navigate.
whenNotToUse: Content the user needs — hover is unavailable on touch and to many keyboard users.
Anything required to complete a task.

notes: Reachable on keyboard focus, or its content must exist elsewhere.

states.Density=Compact: fill popover · border stroke/1 border · radius radius/lg · padding space/4 · gap space/2 · text popover-foreground · type Heading/XS · text muted-foreground · type Body/SM
